description: This Java source file defines the OnStopHandler class, which manages a Consumer<StoppedTimer> to be invoked when a timer stops. It provides methods to handle a StoppedTimer object by passing it to the registered consumer.

classes.name: OnStopHandler
classes.description: Contains a Consumer<StoppedTimer> which is invoked when a Timer stops.
